name: Misa
message: 「Do you know... what day today is?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-well, maybe it is, but that's not the answer I'm looking for!」

name: Misa
message: 「Not 'Norimaki Day,' or 'Judy Ongg Day,' or anything like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「So, um, what I'm trying to say is--」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez, you knew it was my birthday the whole time and still kept saying stuff like that...」

name: Misa
message: 「But... I love that side of you too」
